title: BPS Recommended Benefit Type Vocabulary
description: Non-normative recommended values for the `benefit_type` field on `benefits[]`, the domain discriminator used to support modules. The first seven values repeat the list in the schema's field description; `hearing` and `non_clinical` were added with the Medicare Advantage examples (see docs/medicare-advantage-notes.md, gap G7). Adopters MAY extend.

benefit_types.label: Medical
benefit_types.description: Medical services (the default when benefit_type is absent).

benefit_types.label: Pharmacy
benefit_types.description: Outpatient prescription drug benefits, including Medicare Part D.

benefit_types.label: Behavioral health
benefit_types.description: Mental health and substance use services.

benefit_types.label: Pediatric
benefit_types.description: Pediatric services, including the ACA pediatric dental and vision benefits.

benefit_types.label: Hearing
benefit_types.description: Hearing exams and hearing aids, Medicare-covered or supplemental.

benefit_types.label: Non-clinical
benefit_types.description: Services that are not clinical care, such as transportation, meals, in-home support, fitness programs, a personal emergency response system, and member support. Stopgap name carried from the Medicare Advantage notes; the two source documents do not use a collective term.
